_comment: Tier-2 for skfem convection_diffusion#0, a catalog-drift correction. Measured on skfem 12.0.1, MeshTri().refined(2) / ElementTriP1: skfem.helpers.grad(u) and u.grad[i] both assemble to a matrix bit-identical to skfem.models.poisson.laplace (nnz 105, max abs difference exactly 0.0), so the prior 'grad(u) raises NameError' claim is false. What DOES bite is the numpy @ operator on the (dim, n_elem, n_qp) DiscreteField arrays, which raises the gufunc core-dimension ValueError; and a genuinely undefined free function raises the ordinary Python NameError at call time, which is how the two are told apart.
expect_in_output: matmul: Input operand 1 has a mismatch in its core dimension
